post.summary: GetAuditHistory is used to get the audit history of a key

GetEntityAggregate gets all the data for an entity in all domains
TODO: aggregate query for only one type of query pattern is allowed at present
others support will follow with some long term solution with a columnar storage later

Get gets a list of keys's values This is like a graphql request
than a restapi's single resource GET. Clients can specify partial objects
by using field masks

Patch is used to change few fields of an object in one request
If you wish to replace the complete object in the kv store, use Put
Put adds or replace a key with a value

changeBy.title: change_by store who made the change

changeReason.title: change_reason is used to log the reason for change

changeApprovedBy.title: change_approved_by log who approved the change

changeValue.title:
change_value stores the value of the change
do not send this field, overwritten by the kv server

serviceName.title:
service_name is the name of the service from where the call was made
to configuration service
do not send this field, overwritten by the kv server

action.title:
action is used to find if the change was put or patch
do not send this field, overwritten by the kv server

createdTime.title: created_time at which the log was created

v1AuditLog.title: AuditLog for logging the metadata associated with the change

v1Field.title: Field represent the field of the object

key.title: key for which the audit is needed

count.title:
count represent the number of audit logs needed
from latest to oldest

v1GetAuditHistoryRequest.title: GetAuditHistoryRequest is the request for getting audit history

auditLogs.title:
audit_logs return the list of audit logs
from latest to oldest oreder

v1GetAuditHistoryResponse.title: GetAuditHistoryResponse is the response for audit history

entity.title: entity is same the entity in the Key above

entityId.title: entity_id is the same entity_id as in the Key above

kvs.title:
kvs is the list of key-value pairs
response for the get request

v1GetEntityAggregateResponse.title: GetEntityAggregateResponse returns the entity aggregate response

queries.title: queries is the list of keys the client is interested in

v1GetRequest.title: GetRequest gets the values for all the keys specified in querie(s)

kvs.title:
kvs is the list of key-value pairs
response for the get request

v1GetResponse.title: GetResponse returns the response for GET request

namespace.title:
namespace represents an root of Key value tree
namespace is the top level dir under which all key-value data exist
namespace is: payments, capital, razorpayx
examples:
github.com/razorpay/config-proto/payments
github.com/razorpay/config-proto/capital
github.com/razorpay/config-proto/razorpayx

domain.title:
domain represents the domain in the namespace
domain is: refund, settlement, terminal
examples:
github.com/razorpay/config-proto/payments/refund
github.com/razorpay/config-proto/capital/settlement
github.com/razorpay/config-proto/platform/stork

entity.title:
entity represents the entity in that domain
entity: merchant, email
examples:
github.com/razorpay/config-proto/payments/refund/merchant
github.com/razorpay/config-proto/payments/settlement/merchant
github.com/razorpay/config-proto/platform/stork/email

entityId.title:
entity_id represents a unique key to identify a entity
examples:
entity_id: 67186GHAYZP_mid_swiggy
/payments/refund/merchant/67186GHAYZP_mid_swiggy

objectName.description:
dir: github.com/razorpay/config-proto/payments/refund/merchant/transfer_settings.proto
  object_name: TransferSettings

Not Allowed objects:
  dir: github.com/razorpay/config-proto/payments/refund/merchant/nested/features.proto
  object_name: Nested/Features
objectName.title:
object_name represents the name of the object in the key
it is the name of the message in the proto file
we support only one level of proto files under entity at present
Allowed objects:
  dir: github.com/razorpay/config-proto/payments/refund/merchant/features.proto
  object_name: Features

v1Key.title:
Key represents a key in the key value store
Key=/namespace/domain/entity/entity_id/object_name
examples:
/payments/refund/merchant/67186GHAYZP_mid_swiggy/refund_flags
/payments/refund/merchant/67186GHAYZP_mid_swiggy/transfer_settings

key.title: key is the key in the key-value store

value.title: value is the object for the key in the key-value store

v1KeyValue.title: KeyValue keeps the key and value together, used for response

key.title: key is the key, to put into the key-value store

value.title: value contains the partial filled object as bytes

fieldmasks.title: fieldmasks define the list of fields that are required to be patched in the object

auditLog.title: audit_log stores the information related to the change

v1PatchRequest.title:
PatchRequest sets the complete object at a key in kv store
It is used to create the new resource or replace the existing resource
It is idempotent in nature: if you PUT an object twice, it should have
no additional effect. Two PUT requests would result same thing

count.title:
count tells the number of fields
that was modified in the key

v1PatchResponse.title: PatchResponse is the response for a PatchRequest

key.title: key is the key, to put into the key-value store

value.title: value is the bytes of the key object in the key-value store

auditLog.title: audit_log stores the information related to the change

v1PutRequest.title:
PutRequest sets the complete object at a key in kv store
It is used to create the new resource or replace the existing resource
It is idempotent in nature: if you PUT an object twice, it should have
no additional effect. Two PUT requests would result same thing

v1PutResponse.title: PutResponse is the response for a PutRequest

key.title: key is the key in the key-value store

fieldmasks.title:
fieldmasks can be used by clients to get the partial data back in response
instead of getting the complete object. specify the fields you are interested in
the object as a list of strings

v1Query.title: Query is the single get request for one key

bearer.description: Authentication token, prefixed by bearer: bearer <token>
bearer.name: Authorization
